001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages;
002
003import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.bluetooth.Characteristic;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.bluetooth.PumpStateSupplier;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.bluetooth.models.Packet;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
007import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.shared.L;
008
009import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.shared.Hex;
010import org.apache.commons.codec.digest.HmacAlgorithms;
011import org.apache.commons.codec.digest.HmacUtils;
012import org.apache.commons.lang3.ArrayUtils;
013import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
014
015import java.util.ArrayList;
016import java.util.Arrays;
017import java.util.List;
018import java.util.stream.Collectors;
019
020
021public class Packetize {
022    public static final String TAG = "Packetize";
023    public static TransactionId txId = new TransactionId();
024
025    // TODO: these comments about chunk size are almost certainly due to the MTU.
026    public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_CHUNK_SIZE = 18; // This was observed for currentStatus. It may be 40 for control.
027    public static final int CONTROL_MAX_CHUNK_SIZE = 40; // this is a guess, it works for control.BolusPermissionResponse. maybe it should actually be 20?
028
029    private static int determineMaxChunkSize(Message message) {
030        if (message.getCharacteristic().equals(Characteristic.CONTROL) && message.type().equals(MessageType.REQUEST)) {
031            L.t(TAG, "using maxChunkSize="+CONTROL_MAX_CHUNK_SIZE+" for control request characteristic");
032            return CONTROL_MAX_CHUNK_SIZE;
033        }
034
035        return DEFAULT_MAX_CHUNK_SIZE;
036    }
037
038    public static List<Packet> packetize(Message message, byte[] authenticationKey, byte currentTxId) {
039        Validate.notNull(message, "packetize requires a message");
040        return packetize(message, authenticationKey, currentTxId, determineMaxChunkSize(message));
041    }
042
043    public static List<Packet> packetize(Message message, byte[] authenticationKey, byte currentTxId, int maxChunkSize) {
044        // These were logged and then execution continued into the dereference a few lines below,
045        // so the only thing the log added was a line above the NullPointerException. Rejecting
046        // here names the message that failed, and does not log the authentication key to do it.
047        Validate.notNull(message, "packetize requires a message");
048        Validate.notNull(message.getCargo(),
049                "packetize requires cargo, messageName=" + message.messageName());
050
051        int length = 3 + message.getCargo().length;
052        if (message.signed()) {
053            length += 24;
054        }
055        byte[] packet = new byte[length];
056        packet[0] = (byte) message.opCode();
057        packet[1] = currentTxId;
058        packet[2] = (byte) (length - 3);
059        // packet[3 ... N] filled with message cargo
060        System.arraycopy(message.getCargo(), 0, packet, 3, message.getCargo().length);
061
062        //L.d(TAG, "packetize signed "+message.signed()+": packetBefore="+ Hex.encodeHexString(packet));
063        if (message.props().modifiesInsulinDelivery() && !PumpStateSupplier.actionsAffectingInsulinDeliveryEnabled.get()) {
064            throw new ActionsAffectingInsulinDeliveryNotEnabledInPumpX2Exception();
065        }
066        if (message.signed()) {
067            int i = length - 20;
068            byte[] messageData = new byte[i];
069            System.arraycopy(packet, 0, messageData, 0, i);
070            long pumpStateTimeSinceReset = PumpStateSupplier.pumpTimeSinceReset.get();
071            byte[] timeSinceReset = Bytes.toUint32(pumpStateTimeSinceReset);
072            System.arraycopy(timeSinceReset, 0, messageData, length - 24, 4);
073
074            L.d(TAG, "using authenticationKey=" + Hex.encodeHexString(authenticationKey) + " pumpTimeSinceReset=" + pumpStateTimeSinceReset);
075
076            byte[] hmacSha1Output = doHmacSha1(messageData, authenticationKey);
077            System.arraycopy(messageData, 0, packet, 0, i);
078            System.arraycopy(hmacSha1Output, 0, packet, i, hmacSha1Output.length);
079        }
080        //L.d(TAG, "packetize packetAfter="+ Hex.encodeHexString(packet));
081
082        // Append CRC to packet
083        byte[] crc = Bytes.calculateCRC16(packet);
084        byte[] packetWithCRC = ArrayUtils.addAll(packet, crc);
085        //L.d(TAG, "packetize packetWithCRC="+ Hex.encodeHexString(packetWithCRC));
086
087        // Fill Packet list with chunks of size 18 (maxChunkSize)
088        List<Packet> packets = new ArrayList<>();
089        List<List<Byte>> chunked = partitionList(packetWithCRC, maxChunkSize);
090
091        int b = chunked.size() - 1;
092        for (List<Byte> bytes : chunked) {
093            byte[] elem = ArrayUtils.toPrimitive(bytes.toArray(new Byte[0]));
094            packets.add(new Packet((byte) b, currentTxId, elem));
095            b--;
096        }
097
098        return packets;
099    }
100
101
102    public static List<List<Byte>> partitionList(byte[] packetWithCRC, int partitionSize) {
103        // A non-positive size never satisfies the size check below, so every byte accumulated
104        // into one partition and the whole packet went out as a single unchunked Packet rather
105        // than failing. Reject it instead.
106        Validate.isTrue(partitionSize > 0, "partitionSize must be positive, got %d", partitionSize);
107
108        List<List<Byte>> partitions = new ArrayList<>();
109        List<Byte> subList = new ArrayList<>();
110
111        for (byte b : packetWithCRC) {
112            subList.add(b);
113            if (subList.size() == partitionSize) {
114                partitions.add(subList);
115                subList = new ArrayList<>();
116            }
117        }
118
119        if (!subList.isEmpty()) {
120            partitions.add(subList);
121        }
122
123        return partitions;
124    }
125
126
127    public static byte[] doHmacSha1(byte[] data, byte[] key) {
128        return new HmacUtils(HmacAlgorithms.HMAC_SHA_1, key).hmac(data);
129    }
130
131    public static class ActionsAffectingInsulinDeliveryNotEnabledInPumpX2Exception extends RuntimeException {
132        ActionsAffectingInsulinDeliveryNotEnabledInPumpX2Exception() {
133            super("The developer of this application has not enabled actions which affect insulin delivery");
134        }
135    }
136}
